about: V6 voiceover screen map: the founder's final performance (P1–P8) is the master clock. Every spoken line with where it lands, what is on screen, the camera, the cursor, the SFX, the music and the captions. Generated by scripts/build-v7-audio.py.
voice_direction: Abhishek Meena's own voice (or an ElevenLabs clone of it made with the founder's permission). Calm, deep, precise, technical, confident, understated, founder-led — natural to Abhishek's own accent. Not a commercial announcer, trailer voice, AI voice, overly American, overly dramatic, or fast social-media narration.
